messages:
Elaine (Product): quick sync — I put together a launch-readiness matrix to deconflict latency / throughput / cost asks vs customer SLAs. need alignment before we lock the roadmap. TL;DR: propose gating rules + RICE-like scoring + SLA overrides.
Mike (Eng): can you drop the matrix here?
Elaine (Product): pasted below — compact RICE variant we used for infra: `Score = (Reach * Impact * Confidence) / Effort`. added two extra cols: `SLA-risk` and `Ops-cost-delta`.
Elaine (Product): rows: chat-hotpath (low-latency), embeddings-bulk (high-throughput), reranking-batches (medium), dedicated-dedup (enterprise isolation).
Sanjay (ML): quick takes — chat-hotpath: Reach=9 (many customers), Impact=8 (revenue+retention), Confidence=6 (perf unknown on 2k tokens), Effort=5 dev-wks, SLA-risk=high, Ops-cost-delta=+30%. RICE-ish score ~ (9*8*6)/5 = 86.
Mike (Eng): embeddings-bulk: Reach=6, Impact=5, Confidence=8 (we already have good throughput), Effort=2, SLA-risk=low, Ops-cost-delta=+5% => score ~120. batching + prefix cache wins here.
Zoe (CS): FYI — AcmeCorp explicitly requires 95p <200ms for chat for go-live. if we don't meet that, they delay contract. big $$ and reference customer.
Ana (PM): so SLA overrides are real. maybe gating rule: any feature that causes SLA breach for an existing contract auto-promote to high priority.
Mike (Eng): agree SLA override. ops note: achieving 95p<200ms for chat likely needs kernel optimizations + endpoint isolation (extra infra). that pushes cost.
Sanjay (ML): alternative: degrade model at prefix detection for hotpath (shorter context / distilled variant) — lowers latency without full infra change. but accuracy regression risk.
Elaine (Product): proposal: 1) apply RICE threshold 50+ for roadmap inclusion; 2) SLA-override clause (any customer-impacting SLA moves to top of next sprint); 3) require measurable launch criteria: 95p latency, regression delta on NPS/quality <2%. 4) sequencing: put embeddings-bulk in parallel with a canary for chat-hotpath (canary = subset of traffic + auto-fallback to standard model).
Zoe (CS): can we add rollout policy: canary ramp to 10% for 24h, check error/latency/quality gates, then 50% for 48h? customers want deterministic timelines.
Mike (Eng): ops-bot: deploy-cost-estimate: chat-hotpath canary ~ +0.4 vCPU per 1k QPS, expected infra delta ~ +25% for canary window.
ops-bot: [automated] schedule note created: infra-estimate-ticket #INF-4829 linked.
Sanjay (ML): I'm concerned about confidence numbers — we should run microbenchmarks across seq-lens and model variants before final scoring. otherwise Confidence stays low and we under/over-prioritize.
Elaine (Product): agreed — action items: (a) Mike & Sanjay run perf sweep by EOD Thu, publish numbers, (b) Zoe to surface any SLA customers + priority, (c) Ana will update roadmap doc with gating rules. we'll reconvene Fri 10am to finalize.
Ana (PM): +1. if perf sweep looks good we promote chat-hotpath to Q2 canary, embeddings-bulk Q3. if not, swap sequencing.
Zoe (CS): :thumbsup: I'll flag AcmeCorp and BetaBank as SLA-critical.
Mike (Eng): noted. adding perf tests to CI and a lightweight KV-prefix cache experiment.
Elaine (Product): thanks all — trying to keep this small and measurable. final note: please use the matrix spreadsheet I shared (link) for concrete numbers, don't rely on these back-of-envelope scores when we vote. :thinking:
